verses.text: 'When a man takes a wife and marries her, and it happens that she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some indecency in her, and he writes her a certificate of divorce and puts [it] in her hand and sends her out from his house,
verses.textZh: 人若娶妻以後，見他有甚麼不合理的事，不喜悅他，就可以寫休書交在他手中，打發他離開夫家。

verses.text: and she leaves his house and goes and becomes another man's [wife],
verses.textZh: 婦人離開夫家以後，可以去嫁別人。

verses.text: and if the latter husband turns against her and writes her a certificate of divorce and puts [it] in her hand and sends her out of his house, or if the latter husband dies who took her to be his wife,
verses.textZh: 後夫若恨惡他，寫休書交在他手中，打發他離開夫家，或是娶他為妻的後夫死了，

verses.text: [then] her former husband who sent her away is not allowed to take her again to be his wife, since she has been defiled; for that is an abomination before the LORD, and you shall not bring sin on the land which the LORD your God gives you as an inheritance.
verses.textZh: 打發他去的前夫不可在婦人玷污之後再娶他為妻，因為這是耶和華所憎惡的；不可使耶和華─你神所賜為業之地被玷污了。

verses.text: 'When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out with the army nor be charged with any duty; he shall be free at home one year and shall give happiness to his wife whom he has taken.
verses.textZh: 新娶妻之人不可從軍出征，也不可託他辦理甚麼公事，可以在家清閒一年，使他所娶的妻快活。

verses.text: 'No one shall take a handmill or an upper millstone in pledge, for he would be taking a life in pledge.
verses.textZh: 不可拿人的全盤磨石或是上磨石作當頭，因為這是拿人的命作當頭。

verses.text: 'If a man is caught kidnapping any of his countrymen of the sons of Israel, and he deals with him violently or sells him, then that thief shall die; so you shall purge the evil from among you.
verses.textZh: 若遇見人拐帶以色列中的一個弟兄，當奴才待他，或是賣了他，那拐帶人的就必治死。這樣，便將那惡從你們中間除掉。

verses.text: 'Be careful against an infection of leprosy, that you diligently observe and do according to all that the Levitical priests teach you; as I have commanded them, so you shall be careful to do.
verses.textZh: 在大痲瘋的災病上，你們要謹慎，照祭司利未人一切所指教你們的留意遵行。我怎樣吩咐他們，你們要怎樣遵行。

verses.text: 'Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam on the way as you came out of Egypt.
verses.textZh: 當記念出埃及後，在路上，耶和華─你神向米利暗所行的事。

verses.text: 'When you make your neighbor a loan of any sort, you shall not enter his house to take his pledge.
verses.textZh: 你借給鄰舍，不拘是甚麼，不可進他家拿他的當頭。

verses.text: 'You shall remain outside, and the man to whom you make the loan shall bring the pledge out to you.
verses.textZh: 要站在外面，等那向你借貸的人把當頭拿出來交給你。

verses.text: 'If he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge.
verses.textZh: 他若是窮人，你不可留他的當頭過夜。

verses.text: 'When the sun goes down you shall surely return the pledge to him, that he may sleep in his cloak and bless you; and it will be righteousness for you before the LORD your God.
verses.textZh: 日落的時候，總要把當頭還他，使他用那件衣服蓋著睡覺，他就為你祝福；這在耶和華─你神面前就是你的義了。

verses.text: 'You shall not oppress a hired servant [who is] poor and needy, whether [he is] one of your countrymen or one of your aliens who is in your land in your towns.
verses.textZh: 困苦窮乏的雇工，無論是你的弟兄或是在你城裡寄居的，你不可欺負他。

verses.text: 'You shall give him his wages on his day before the sun sets, for he is poor and sets his heart on it; so that he will not cry against you to the LORD and it become sin in you.
verses.textZh: 要當日給他工價，不可等到日落─因為他窮苦，把心放在工價上─恐怕他因你求告耶和華，罪便歸你了。

verses.text: 'Fathers shall not be put to death for [their] sons, nor shall sons be put to death for [their] fathers; everyone shall be put to death for his own sin.
verses.textZh: 不可因子殺父，也不可因父殺子；凡被殺的都為本身的罪。

verses.text: 'You shall not pervert the justice due an alien [or] an orphan, nor take a widow's garment in pledge.
verses.textZh: 你不可向寄居的和孤兒屈枉正直，也不可拿寡婦的衣裳作當頭。

verses.text: 'But you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and that the LORD your God redeemed you from there; therefore I am commanding you to do this thing.
verses.textZh: 要記念你在埃及作過奴僕。耶和華─你的神從那裡將你救贖，所以我吩咐你這樣行。

verses.text: 'When you reap your harvest in your field and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go back to get it; it shall be for the alien, for the orphan, and for the widow, in order that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
verses.textZh: 你在田間收割莊稼，若忘下一捆，不可回去再取，要留給寄居的與孤兒寡婦。這樣，耶和華─你神必在你手裡所辦的一切事上賜福與你。

verses.text: 'When you beat your olive tree, you shall not go over the boughs again; it shall be for the alien, for the orphan, and for the widow.
verses.textZh: 你打橄欖樹，枝上剩下的，不可再打；要留給寄居的與孤兒寡婦。

verses.text: 'When you gather the grapes of your vineyard, you shall not go over it again; it shall be for the alien, for the orphan, and for the widow.
verses.textZh: 你摘葡萄園的葡萄，所剩下的，不可再摘；要留給寄居的與孤兒寡婦。

verses.text: 'You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt; therefore I am commanding you to do this thing.
verses.textZh: 你也要記念你在埃及地作過奴僕，所以我吩咐你這樣行。
